tei:div.tei:p: ༈ rin chen mkha' 'gro'i dur khrod kyi rgyud bzhugs so/ / rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma gcig lab kyi sgron ma yis/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro'i dur khrod gling chen gyi/ /mkha' 'gro dbang du bsdus nas bran la bkol/ /thod smyon bsam 'grub kyis snyan du brgyud/ de la lho phyogs dur khrod kyi mkha' 'gro ma stag gi mgo can/ lho phyogs gling chen bzhi la yang de 'dra bzhi/ de sgrub pa'i skor ni/ maṇ+ḍal sa tshon gong dang 'dra/ bskyed rim ni/ rang dur khrod kyi mkha' 'gro ma sku+u mdog ser mo stag mgo can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ sku la dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas zhing chen gyi rgyal mtshan/ g.yon pas nor bu/ rang gi dbu thog nas rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum bskyed/ snying gi dkyil du'ang rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum/ de'i shar du sngon mo stag gi mgo can/ lho phyogs su ser mo stag mgo ma/ nub tu dmar mo stag mgo can/ byang du ljang mo stag mgo ma/ gsang ba'i gnas chen bzhi la/ de 'dra bzhi yod/ rang gi phyogs bzhir de 'dra bzhi bsgom/ g.yas thams cad zhing gi rgyal mtshan/ g.yon thams cad na nor bu/ sku+u la dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa ha dang hūm̐ gi sgra sgrog pa/ gsang ba'i gnas chen bzhi'i dur khrod kyi mkha' 'gro ma bkug cing*/ rang gi phyogs mtshams thams cad du 'ub kyis 'dus par bskyed/ de nas ngag tu phaṭa brjod pas/ de rnams kyi stong gsum gyi bcud dang tshe bkrag bsdus nas rang la bstims/ phaṭa drag tu brjod nas 'gro ba pho mo dbang du bsdus nas rang la thims/ bran g.yog gi tshul du 'khor bar bskyed/ de nas snying po 'di nyid bgrangs/ ha ri ni sa ma ma rat+na drongs/ mu 'dus ha ya phaṭa/ ha ri ni sa ra na bang 'dus/ de dus snying po grangs med bsgrangs la/ gnyan khrod 'grim zhing dmigs pa gcun na thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa thob par 'gyur ro/

/rin chen dur khrod gsang sgrub rdzogs so// // ༈ dur khrod kyi gnas su nyal ba'i dus su/ dur khrod ro chas kyi dmigs pa 'di bzhin bya'o/ /rang gi mdun dur khrod kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ sku mdog ser mo stag gi mgo can/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod khrag /sku la dur khrod chas kyis brgyan pa zhig tu bskyed de/ phaṭa byas la rig pa dbyings su thims/ rang gi smin mtshams nas rbad kyis bcad la mdun du bzhag /brang breg snying bton de'i nang du bcug /sha khrag rnams de'i nang du spungs/ zhal bu'i nang du raṃ zhig bskyed la/ raṃ las me 'bar bag chags dri ma rnams bsregs pas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis byin gyis brlabs/ yar bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la dngas ma 'bul/ bar yon tan gyi mgron la 'bul/ tha ma lan chags dang snying rje'i mgron la 'bul/ dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams la 'bul/ yon tan gyi mgron rnams skong bar gyur cig /lan chags kyi mgron rnams tshims par gyur cig /snying rje'i mgron rnams phun sum tshogs par gyur cig /yang na tshogs gsogs 'di ltar bya/ rang gi mdun du mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog ser skya zhig /phaṭa byas pas rig pa ma la bstim/ lpags pa de dmar phyam gyis bting nas/ stong gsum gang bar bsam/ yang phaṭa byas pas sha rnams nyil gyis song*/ khrag rnams bdud rtsir ltem gyis song*/ rus pa rnams 'dod dgur song*/ phaṭa byas pas mgo bo de klu'i pho brang chen po zhig tu bsam/ klu thams cad kyi bcud bsdus nas bstim/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis g.yos byas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la dngas ma 'bul/ /snyigs ma rigs drug lan chags yongs la bsngo/ /dgos 'dod phun sum tshogs pa'i tshogs gsogs 'di/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul/ /tshangs pa brgya byin rgyal chen sde bzhi mnyes gyur cig

/lan chags 'gro drug tshims gyur cig /rang gi mdun du mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog ser mo stag gi mgo can bskyed la/ phaṭa byas pas rig pa rang la bstim/ lpags pa dmar phyam gyis song ba la/ g.yang gzhi zhig tu gyur par bsam/ gling bzhi khengs par bsam/ mgo bo 'dzam bu'i gling du yod par bsam/ phaṭa byas pas sha rus rnams nyil gyis song bar bsam/ 'dod yon phun sum tshogs par bsam/ khrag rnams bdud rtsir bsam/ phaṭa byas pas ri'i rgyal po ri rab 'dod dgu phun sum tshogs par bsam/ khrag rnams bdud rtsir bsam/ phaṭa byas pas ri'i rgyal po ri rab phun sum tshogs par gling bzhi'i skye 'gro'i bcud bsdus nas/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsreg sbyangs bya/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la/ bdud rtsi dri zhim pa/ ro mngar ba/ phun sum tshogs pa phul bas mnyes par bsam/ yon tan gyi mgron rnams thams cad dang*/ rigs drug rnams la phul bas phun sum tshogs par gyur cig /da ni gzugs bskyur la/ rang gi mdun gyi bar snang la/ ma cig bskyed la rig pa de la bstim/ phaṭa byas pas mgo bo bcad nas snang srid kyi lha 'dre thams cad kyi dbang po rnam pa lnga tshims par bsam/ /yang phaṭa byas pas/ lag g.yas bcad nas snang srid kyi lha 'dre thams cad tshims par bsam/ yang phaṭa byas pas rkang pa g.yas bcad nas snang srid lha 'dre thams cad tshims par bsam/ phaṭa byas pas lag pa g.yon pas tshims par bsam/ phaṭa byas pas rkang pa g.yon pas tshims par bsam/ yang phaṭa byas pas zo khog de lha ma srin sde brgyad kyis zos nas tshims par bsam/ khrag gi mtsho mo kun gyis 'thungs pas tshims par bsam mo// //dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /maṅgalaṃ//
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (26)rin chen mkha' 'gro'i dur khrod kyi rgyud/ - PAGE 40 -- PAGE 41 -- PAGE 39 -
